scripts.text: Finally I've found you, Vagabond Spike! Your neck is mine!
scripts.translation: 终于找到你了，流浪者斯派克！拿命来！

scripts.text: *Snort* Don't pretend like you don't know. Look at this poster! You're in it!
scripts.translation: *哼*别装作不知道。看看这张通缉令！上面就是你！

scripts.text: I see the resemblance, but that's not me.
scripts.translation: 我看确实有几分相似，但那不是我。

scripts.text: Forget the resemblance. Where did you get that poster? I've never committed a crime.
scripts.translation: 别说长得像了。你从哪儿弄来的通缉令？我从没犯过罪。

scripts.text: I knew you'd try to lie your way out.
scripts.translation: 我就知道你会想办法狡辩。

scripts.text: The ^0000ffEinbroch Private Pub^000000 has released that wanted poster. You have many bounty hunters like me on your heels.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff艾因布洛克私人酒吧^000000发布了那张通缉令。像我这样的赏金猎人正追着你呢。

scripts.text: I don't care if you're the right one so long as you look it and I can take you dead or alive.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎你是不是真犯人，只要你看起来像他，我就能把你活着或死着带回去。

scripts.text: It's you again! You've got guts to come back here!
scripts.translation: 又是你！居然还有胆子回来！

scripts.text: ^0000ffI should run for now and think about this later.^000000
^0000ffHe's not the only bounty hunter after me, if he's telling the truth. I need time to strategize.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff如果他说的是真的，盯上我的赏金猎人可不止一个，得从长计议。^000000

scripts.text: *Gasp* You! I thought you were already captured. Ooh, doesn't matter now. You're my Get Out of Jail Free card!
scripts.translation: *喘气*是你！我还以为你已经被抓了。哦，不过现在无所谓了。你就是我的免罪护身符！

scripts.text: I'm not the criminal you think I am!
scripts.translation: 我不是你以为的那个罪犯！

scripts.text: Hm, you bear a striking resemblance, though you don't look not as menacing as that criminal Spike
scripts.translation: 嗯，你和他长得真像，不过看起来没那个罪犯斯派克那么凶狠。

scripts.text: I want to talk to the poster publisher.
scripts.translation: 我要见发布通缉令的人

scripts.text: Your problem is a bit out of my league. Get in. If I find out you're the real deal all along, I'll see that you'll never see the outside again.
scripts.translation: 你的麻烦我可处理不了。进去吧。要是查出你真是那家伙，我保证你再也别想出来。

scripts.text: Go ahead. Stay out of trouble.
Do you know how to use a gun?
Don't say I look like a blacksmith you know.
Oh wait, am I in the pub or someplace else? Zzz...
scripts.translation: 等等，我是在酒吧还是别的什么地方？呼...

scripts.text: Maybe I'm in the wrong place. This place doesn't look like a pub.
scripts.translation: 我可能走错地方了。这里看起来不像酒吧。

scripts.text: Do you want to see the boss?
Wait a minute... Mwah hah hah!

scripts.translation: ^0000ff他看了看你的脸，然后大笑起来。^000000

scripts.text: I'm sorry. For a moment, I thought Spike came back to life. He was found dead three days ago.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，刚才我还以为斯派克死而复生了。他三天前被发现已经死了。

scripts.text: Yes, and the bounty hunter was already paid. The news hasn't spread, and you're the spitting image of him. Go figure.
scripts.translation: 没错，赏金已经付给猎人了。消息还没传开，而你又和他长得一模一样。真是巧啊。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I can't talk to every single bounty hunter for you. Of course, I'm willing to compensate for your inconvenience.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不能替你逐个去找那些赏金猎人谈。不过我愿意补偿你受到的麻烦。

scripts.text: Hey, how about you join our ranks? At the very last, you won't get shot.
scripts.translation: 嘿，要不要加入我们？至少这样就不会被人开枪打了。

scripts.text: You want me become a bounty hunter?
scripts.translation: 你想让我成为赏金猎人？

scripts.text: No, bounty hunting is just a pastime. We're the experts of all the firearms in the world.
scripts.translation: 不，赏金狩猎只是消遣。我们才是精通世上一切枪械的专家。

scripts.text: You look like you know how to use a gun. How'd you like to join our ranks? You won't have to worry about other bounty hunters anymore too.
scripts.translation: 看起来你会用枪。要不要加入我们？这样也不用再担心其他赏金猎人了。

scripts.text: I don't think I have a choice.
You can think it over and over, but the answer won't change. Just take the offer.
scripts.translation: 你想再久，答案也不会变。接受邀请吧。

scripts.text: Good thinking. Might as well do it now and get it over with.
scripts.translation: 想得好。倒不如现在就加入，一了百了。

scripts.text: Talk to Enwin Conick. She guides drifting spirits like you to the way of the Rebellion. I'll send word to her. Ah, and don't point your gun at her.
scripts.translation: 去找艾尔温·科尼克谈谈。她会引导你这样的迷途之人走上反叛者之路。我会通知她。对了，别拿枪指着她。

scripts.text: Do you have business with Elwin Conick?
scripts.translation: 你是来找艾尔温·科尼克的吗？
带我去找埃尔温·科尼克

scripts.text: All right. Care for a shot of vodka?
scripts.translation: 好啊。要来一杯伏特加吗？

scripts.text: If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation: 不想加入反叛者就出去。

scripts.text: Do you to join us Rebellions?
scripts.translation: 你要加入我们反叛者吗？

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe short woman with keen eyes stares into your eyes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff那位目光锐利的矮个子女子凝视着你的眼睛。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe undersigned party '_____' will not speak of the test even if he or she suffers injury, mutilation, or death in an unforeseen accident that may occur during the test.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff签署人“_____”承诺，即使在测试期间遭遇不可预见的事故，导致受伤、致残或死亡，也不会泄露测试内容。^000000

scripts.text: Do you want join us or not?
scripts.translation: 你到底要不要加入我们？

scripts.text: Do you want to try again?
You still have Ivan's shooting test, do you want to try again?
scripts.translation: 你还没完成伊万的射击测试，要再试一次吗？

scripts.text: Ivan's shooting test have not finished yet, do you want to try again?
scripts.translation: 伊万的射击测试还没结束，要再试一次吗？

scripts.text: It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation: 现在放弃不值得，先出去放松一下吧。

scripts.text: Ivan is waiting for you, go find him.
You have no more test to take. Why don't you go out and have a drink?
scripts.translation: 你没有其他测试要参加了。何不出去喝一杯？

scripts.text: If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation: 不想加入反叛者就出去。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou are already in the test form. If you have finished all your tests, report to Elwin Conick in the Assembly Room^000000.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你已经处于测试变身状态。若已完成全部测试，请到组装室向埃尔温·科尼克报到^000000。

scripts.text: Look at yourself, do you really want to test?
scripts.translation: 看看你自己，你确定还要参加测试吗？

scripts.text: ^0000ffElwin see you turn into another form and she is very angry. Wait for your current form ends, and then find her again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff埃尔温看见你变成别的模样，很不高兴。等变身结束再来找她吧。^000000

scripts.text: Come back when you aren't in any form.
It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation: 现在放弃不值得，先出去放松一下吧。

scripts.text: Any leftover Steel Artifacts must be returned after the test.
scripts.translation: 测试结束后必须归还所有剩余的钢铁零件。

scripts.text: Any leftover Steel Artifacts must be returned after the test.
scripts.translation: 测试结束后必须归还所有剩余的钢铁零件。

scripts.text: Time over. You failed the test. Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation: 时间到了。你没通过测试。把剩余的测试材料都交给我。

scripts.text: Listen up. I'm not going to great lengths trying to explain the test to you.
scripts.translation: 听好了，我不打算费劲给你解释测试。

scripts.text: This is where the firearm molds are cast. Everywhere you can see Steel Artifacts are being produced.
scripts.translation: 这里是铸造枪械模具的地方。你看到的这些钢铁零件都是在这里生产的。

scripts.text: We Rebellions are weapon experts at heart. Here you will learn to create and assemble firearms.
scripts.translation: 我们反叛者天生就是武器专家。你将在这里学习制造和组装枪械。

scripts.text: You'll be asked to control the furnace controller near the entrance and select 5 standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation: 你需要操作入口附近的熔炉控制器，选出5个标准钢铁零件。

scripts.text: You'll then take them to the next Assembly Room and assemble them info a firearm. You'll be given 3 minutes to do all that. You'd better be fast and focused, or you will fail the test.
scripts.translation: 然后把它们带到下一个组装室，组装成一把枪械。你有3分钟完成这一切。动作要快、集中注意力，否则测试就会失败。

scripts.text: I'll be in the next room, waiting for you to bring me a complete firearm. To check the elapsed time, you'll be transformed into a different job. ^0000ffIf you pass 3 minutes and turn back to normal, go back to me and start the test again.^000000.
scripts.translation: 我会在下一个房间等你把完整的枪械带来。为了确认时间，你会变成另一个职业。^0000ff如果3分钟过去后你恢复原样，就回来找我重新开始测试。^000000

scripts.text: You'll be asked to control switches on the machine and select 5 standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation: 你需要操作机器上的开关，选出5个标准钢铁零件。

scripts.text: You'll then take them to the next Assembly Room and assemble them into a complete firearm. You'll be given 3 minutes to finish all that. ^0000ffTo check the elapsed time, you'll be transformed into a different job^000000.
scripts.translation: 然后把它们带到下一个组装室，组装成一把完整的枪械。你有3分钟完成。^0000ff为了确认时间，你会变成另一个职业^000000。

scripts.text: I'll be in the next room, waiting for you to bring me a complete firearm. Remember, ^0000ffyou fail the test when your transformation expires after 3 minutes^000000.
scripts.translation: 我会在下一个房间等你把完整的枪械带来。记住，^0000ff3分钟后变身结束，测试也就失败了^000000。

scripts.text: Ah? Are you lost? You need to register first and then get back here.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你迷路了吗？先去登记，再回来这里。

scripts.text: If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation: 不想加入反叛者就出去。

scripts.text: Are you done? I don't see any completed firearm in your inventory.
scripts.translation: 完成了吗？我没看到你的物品栏里有组装好的枪械。

scripts.text: It's shoddy but not bad, given the time. You passed.
scripts.translation: 做工有点粗糙，不过考虑到时间限制还算不错。你通过了。

scripts.text: Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation: 把测试剩下的材料交给我。

scripts.text: Now you can move on to the next course. Ivan Sidorenko will oversee your test.
scripts.translation: 现在你可以进行下一项课程了。伊万·西多连科会负责你的测试。

scripts.text: Look at yourself, do you really want to test?
scripts.translation: 看看你自己，你确定还要参加测试吗？

scripts.text: ^0000ffElwin see you turn into another form and she is very angry. Wait for your current form ends, and then find her again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff埃尔温看见你变成别的模样，很不高兴。等变身结束再来找她吧。^000000

scripts.text: Come back when you aren't in any form.
It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation: 现在放弃不值得，先出去放松一下吧。

scripts.text: Time over. You failed the test. Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation: 时间到了。你没通过测试。把剩余的测试材料都交给我。

scripts.text: Ah? Are you lost? You need to register first and then get back here.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你迷路了吗？先去登记，再回来这里。

scripts.text: Only authorized user can do the operation.
scripts.translation: 只有获授权的用户才能执行此操作。

scripts.text: Do you want to dredge the mold up from the furnace?
scripts.translation: 要从熔炉中取出模具吗？
正在初始化熔炉控制器 ZX-3100...

scripts.text: Not an authorized user. Abort the operation.
Only authorized user can do the operation.
scripts.translation: 只有获授权的用户才能执行此操作。

scripts.text: Unauthorized firearm creation has been detected. Report to Manager Elwin.
scripts.translation: 检测到未授权的枪械制造行为。请向管理员埃尔温报告。

scripts.text: You do not have standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation: 您没有标准的铁制加工品。

scripts.text: Do you want to use the auto anvil and shape the standard Steel Artifacts into a firearm?
scripts.translation: 您要用自动铁砧将标准的铁制加工品塑造成枪械吗？

scripts.text: For your safety, please step away from the auto anvil.
scripts.translation: 为了您的安全，请远离自动铁砧。

scripts.text: You have successfully created a firearm using the auto anvil. ^ff0000Please report before your transformation expires^000000.
scripts.translation: 已使用自动铁砧成功制造出枪械。^ff0000请在变身结束前报到^000000。

scripts.text: Not an authorized user. Abort the operation.
The system is busy dredging a completed mold from the furnace.
scripts.translation: 系统正忙于从熔炉中取出已完成的模具。

scripts.text: This is shooting test area, you can't come here as you like.
scripts.translation: 这里是射击测试区，不能随便进入。

scripts.text: There seems to be a mistake, you can't stay here.
scripts.translation: 好像出了点差错，你不能待在这里。

scripts.text: Hey, stay focused--we're using live ammo here, and you can get shot anytime.
scripts.translation: 喂，集中注意力——我们用的是真子弹，你随时可能中弹。

scripts.text: Let me make this quick. Basically you'll be running in this shooting range consisting of 5 sections.
scripts.translation: 我简单说明一下。你要在这个由5个区域组成的射击场中行动。

scripts.text: The objective is to find enemies in the midst of a crowd quickly and without fail.
scripts.translation: 目标是在人群中迅速而准确地找出敌人。

scripts.text: Among all the targets, you must shoot only the ^0000ffStandard-issue Targets^000000. If you make a mistake, you'll lose points.
scripts.translation: 所有目标中，你只能射击^0000ff标准靶^000000。射错就会扣分。

scripts.text: Let's try. There aren't many ^0000ffStandard-issue Targets^000000, so keep your eyes peeled.
scripts.translation: 试试看吧。^0000ff标准靶^000000不多，所以要仔细观察。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou have 3 minutes to finish this test. If you can't finish before your transformation expires^000000, you'll fail. If that happens, just follow the path back to me.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你有3分钟完成测试。如果变身结束前还没完成^000000，测试就会失败。失败后沿着路回来找我。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou'll fail if you miss a Standard-issue Target, or shoot 3 incorrect targets^000000. Let's get started.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff漏掉一个标准靶，或射错3个目标，测试就会失败^000000。开始吧。

scripts.text: Good job. I didn't think you could pass so quickly.
scripts.translation: 做得不错，没想到你这么快就通过了。

scripts.text: You may leave and wait outside. I'll bring other instructors' evaluation reports to see you.
scripts.translation: 你可以离开，到外面等候。我会拿其他教官的评估报告来找你。

scripts.text: You're quick enough, but you shot too many incorrect targets. You failed.
scripts.translation: 你的速度够快，但射错的目标太多了。测试失败。

scripts.text: You accurate enough, but you took too much time. Slow Rebellions don't survive long enough.
scripts.translation: 你的准确度不错，但花的时间太长了。动作慢的反叛者活不久。

scripts.text: You failed at both speed and accuracy. How did you survive this long?
scripts.translation: 你的速度和准确度都不合格。你居然能活到现在？

scripts.text: There's a problem, the statistic seems to be wrong. Well... This can happen sometimes.
scripts.translation: 出了点问题，统计数据好像不对。嗯...偶尔会这样。

scripts.text: Let's try again. Be more careful this time.
scripts.translation: 再试一次吧，这回仔细点。

scripts.text: You may leave and wait outside. I'll bring other instructors' evaluation reports to see you.
scripts.translation: 你可以离开，到外面等候。我会拿其他教官的评估报告来找你。

scripts.text: You have too many items, please reduce them to continue.
scripts.translation: 你的物品栏太满了，请整理物品以继续。

scripts.text: The items in your inventory are weighing you down. Lighten your weight first.
scripts.translation: 你背包里的物品太重了，影响了行动。请先减轻负重。

scripts.text: There must have been a mistake. You aren't supposed to remain here.
scripts.translation: 一定是哪里出错了。你不应该留在这里。

scripts.text: Huh? You look so weak? I have nothing more to say.
scripts.translation: 咦？你看起来这么虚弱？我没什么好说的。

scripts.text: Oh no~ You still have Skill Points.
scripts.translation: 哎呀~你还有技能点没用。

scripts.text: Kulbertinov, Elwin, and I've evaluated your Rebellion test results.
scripts.translation: 库尔贝蒂诺夫、艾尔温和我已经评估了你的反叛者测试结果。

scripts.text: You've met all our requirements including the attitude and the test performance.
scripts.translation: 你的态度和测试表现都符合我们的要求。

scripts.text: That's right, you're now a member of the Rebellion. Get ready to be wowed.
scripts.translation: 没错，你现在是反叛者的一员了。准备好大开眼界吧。

scripts.text: And Elwin wants you to have this. Take good care of it. He made it for you.
scripts.translation: 艾尔温把这个送给你。好好保管，这是他特意为你制作的。

scripts.text: This life should be fun, not boring.
scripts.translation: 生活应该充满乐趣，而不是无聊乏味。

scripts.text: And by becoming a Rebellion your life should be upgraded. So, go and create a great journey, make us proud!
scripts.translation: 成为反叛者后，你的人生也该升级了。去开创一段精彩旅程，让我们为你骄傲吧！

scripts.text: Do you have something to say to me, don't you?
Use this temporary storage to keep your items safe while on the Advancement test.
scripts.translation: 参加晋级测试期间，可以用这个临时仓库保管物品。

scripts.text: Thank you for using the service.
What time would you like to return?
